name: Starlight Carousel Over the Ocean
description: A magical carousel made of glowing starlight floats above a calm midnight ocean, each horse crafted from swirling galaxies and trailing stardust.
prompt: A surreal, highly detailed fantasy scene of a grand carousel constructed entirely from luminous starlight and cosmic dust, hovering above a glassy midnight blue ocean under a star-filled sky. Each carousel horse is intricately formed from swirling galaxies, nebulae, and glowing constellations, with trails of sparkling stardust flowing behind them. The carousel platform glows softly with silver and gold light, surrounded by floating orbs of light. The reflection of the entire scene shimmers perfectly on the calm ocean surface below. Art style is hyper-realistic digital painting with soft lighting and dreamy atmosphere.
caption: Sometimes magic doesn't need a circus—just an ocean, a sky full of stars, and a ride through the cosmos. ✨ What constellation would you ride? 🌌
